description:

Donald Trump should listen to his advisors regarding Iran and avoid getting even further into a conflict he “doesn’t know how to get out of,” says former head of the British Army Lord Dannatt.

author: Times News
description:
In 1938, as the shadow of the Holocaust spread across Europe, Catherine Duleep Singh emerged as an extraordinary figure of resistance. The daughter of the last Maharajah of Punjab and goddaughter to Queen Victoria used her position in British society to secure the safety of Jewish families fleeing Nazi Germany. Her intervention was a direct and courageous challenge to the geopolitical horrors of the era.

#royalfamily #punjab #thestory

Matthew Gould was speaking to Rosie Wright and Calum Macdonald on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every day 6-10am.
